title: Shape-tool shapes start and end where PE-DESIGN 11 puts them
description: Eight Shape-tool shapes, each in its own colour, filled with under sewing off: PE-DESIGN 11 starts and ends a rectangle, ellipse, heart, diamond, star and drop where the vertical line through the middle of the shape meets its outline lowest (the middle of a rectangle's bottom edge, the heart's tip), and a triangle at the left end of its bottom edge.

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 black-box survey, 2026-10-27 (pe-gui): 16 Shape-tool shapes drawn with Optimize Entry/Exit Points off; every shape ended where it started. Rectangles (square, wide, tall), ellipses, Round Rectangle, heart, diamond, hexagon, 4- and 5-point stars, crescent and drop start at the lowest outline point on the vertical centre line; triangle, pentagon and octagon at the left end of the bottom edge.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page, with Options ▸ Optimize Entry/Exit Points off, draw with the Shapes tools, each in a different thread colour, line Not Sewn, region Fill Stitch with Under Sewing off and every other attribute at its default: a Rectangle (2,2)–(22,22) mm; a Rectangle (26,2)–(46,12); an Ellipse in the box (50,2)–(70,12); a Heart in (74,2)–(94,22); a Diamond in (2,26)–(22,46); a 4-point star in (26,26)–(46,46); a Triangle in (50,26)–(70,46); a Drop in (74,26)–(94,46). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

machine.make: Sew target/compat/work/shape-start-points/shapes.pes on a Brother machine (medium-weight woven cotton, tear-away): seven colour stops in drawing order; each shape starts and ends at the bottom middle of its outline; every move between shapes is cut (no thread span on top). Record the result.
